name: Ojos Negros (Spain)
description: Blue field with the bars of Aragon along the hoist with a pointed edge, charged with two rows of four black discs (the black eyes).
history: Municipal flag of Ojos Negros; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: stripe with a pointed edge along the hoist bearing the red bars of Aragon
two rows of four black discs
